pyramiding_rule: Zero pyramiding allowed within 0.25 ATR of immediate micro-support/resistance nodes; absolute ban on adding to positions showing negative unrealized drift.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require a 3-bar structural volume confirmation and a Bollinger Band width expansion filter before order generation, prohibiting entries within 15 minutes of high-impact macroeconomic data windows.
profit_harvest_threshold: Initiate aggressive trailing stop activation via SENTINEL_PEAK_HARVEST once unrealized profit crosses +$10.00 to prevent evaporation of floating gains.
